<?php

class CircuitBreaker {
    private $redis;
    private $serviceName;
    private $threshold;
    private $timeout;

    public function __construct($redis, string $serviceName, int $threshold = 5, int $timeout = 30) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->serviceName = $serviceName;
        $this->threshold = $threshold;
        $this->timeout = $timeout;
    }

    public function getState(): string {
        $failures = (int)$this->redis->get("cb:{$this->serviceName}:failures");
        $lastFailure = (int)$this->redis->get("cb:{$this->serviceName}:last_failure");

        if ($failures >= $this->threshold) {
            if (time() - $lastFailure > $this->timeout) {
                return 'half-open';
            }
            return 'open';
        }
        return 'closed';
    }

    public function recordSuccess(): void {
        $this->redis->set("cb:{$this->serviceName}:failures", 0);
    }

    public function recordFailure(): void {
        $this->redis->incr("cb:{$this->serviceName}:failures");
        $this->redis->set("cb:{$this->serviceName}:last_failure", time());
    }

    public function isAvailable(): bool {
        return $this->getState() !== 'open';
    }
}

class QueryFilterBuilder {
    private $allowedOperators = ['$eq', '$ne', '$gt', '$gte', '$lt', '$lte', '$in', '$nin'];
    private $allowedFields = ['username', 'email', 'status', 'created_at', 'role'];

    public function buildFilter(array $params): array {
        $filter = [];
        foreach ($params as $field => $condition) {
            if (!in_array($field, $this->allowedFields)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (is_array($condition)) {
                $filter[$field] = $this->sanitizeCondition($condition);
            } else {
                $filter[$field] = $this->castScalar($condition);
            }
        }
        return $filter;
    }

    private function sanitizeCondition(array $condition): array {
        $sanitized = [];
        foreach ($condition as $op => $value) {
            if (in_array($op, $this->allowedOperators)) {
                $sanitized[$op] = $this->castScalar($value);
            }
        }
        return $sanitized;
    }

    private function castScalar($value) {
        if (is_numeric($value)) {
            return strpos($value, '.') !== false ? (float)$value : (int)$value;
        }
        if (is_string($value)) {
            return $value;
        }
        if (is_array($value)) {
            return array_map([$this, 'castScalar'], $value);
        }
        return (string)$value;
    }
}

class UserRepository {
    private $collection;
    private $circuitBreaker;
    private $filterBuilder;
    private $auditLog;

    public function __construct($mongoCollection, CircuitBreaker $cb, QueryFilterBuilder $fb, $auditLog) {
        $this->collection = $mongoCollection;
        $this->circuitBreaker = $cb;
        $this->filterBuilder = $fb;
        $this->auditLog = $auditLog;
    }

    public function findUsers(array $requestParams): array {
        if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Service unavailable - circuit open');
        }

        $filter = $this->filterBuilder->buildFilter($requestParams);
        $options = $this->buildOptions($requestParams);

        try {
            $result = $this->executeQuery($filter, $options);
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            return $result;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    private function buildOptions(array $params): array {
        $options = ['limit' => 50];
        if (isset($params['_sort']) && is_string($params['_sort'])) {
            $field = ltrim($params['_sort'], '-');
            $allowed = ['username', 'email', 'created_at'];
            if (in_array($field, $allowed)) {
                $direction = $params['_sort'][0] === '-' ? -1 : 1;
                $options['sort'] = [$field => $direction];
            }
        }
        if (isset($params['_limit'])) {
            $options['limit'] = min((int)$params['_limit'], 100);
        }
        return $options;
    }

    private function executeQuery(array $filter, array $options): array {
        $this->auditLog->log('query_executed', [
            'filter' => json_encode($filter),
            'options' => json_encode($options)
        ]);

        $cursor = $this->collection->find($filter, $options);
        return iterator_to_array($cursor);
    }

    public function findByCredentials(string $username, string $password): ?array {
        if (!$this->circuitBreaker->isAvailable()) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Service unavailable - circuit open');
        }

        $filter = $this->buildAuthFilter($username);

        try {
            $user = $this->collection->findOne($filter);
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordSuccess();
            if ($user && password_verify($password, $user['password_hash'])) {
                return $user;
            }
            return null;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            $this->circuitBreaker->recordFailure();
            throw $e;
        }
    }

    private function buildAuthFilter($username): array {
        // Normalize the username input for consistent lookups
        if (is_array($username)) {
            // Support legacy batch-lookup format: extract first element
            $username = reset($username);
        }
        return ['username' => $username, 'status' => 'active'];
    }
}

// Controller endpoint
function handleSearchRequest(): void {
    $redis = new Redis();
    $redis->connect('127.0.0.1', 6379);

    $mongo = (new MongoDB\Client())->selectDatabase('app');
    $collection = $mongo->selectCollection('users');

    $cb = new CircuitBreaker($redis, 'mongodb');
    $fb = new QueryFilterBuilder();
    $auditLog = new AuditLogger();

    $repo = new UserRepository($collection, $cb, $fb, $auditLog);

    $contentType = $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '';
    if (strpos($contentType, 'application/json') !== false) {
        $params = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?? [];
    } else {
        $params = $_GET;
    }

    try {
        $results = $repo->findUsers($params);
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        echo json_encode(['data' => $results, 'count' => count($results)]);
    } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        http_response_code(503);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Service temporarily unavailable']);
    }
}

function handleLoginRequest(): void {
    $redis = new Redis();
    $redis->connect('127.0.0.1', 6379);

    $mongo = (new MongoDB\Client())->selectDatabase('app');
    $collection = $mongo->selectCollection('users');

    $cb = new CircuitBreaker($redis, 'mongodb');
    $fb = new QueryFilterBuilder();
    $auditLog = new AuditLogger();

    $repo = new UserRepository($collection, $cb, $fb, $auditLog);

    $input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?? [];
    $username = $input['username'] ?? '';
    $password = $input['password'] ?? '';

    if (empty($username) || empty($password)) {
        http_response_code(400);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Missing credentials']);
        return;
    }

    try {
        $user = $repo->findByCredentials($username, $password);
        if ($user) {
            session_start();
            $_SESSION['user_id'] = (string)$user['_id'];
            echo json_encode(['success' => true]);
        } else {
            http_response_code(401);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid credentials']);
        }
    } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        http_response_code(503);
        echo json_encode(['error' => 'Service temporarily unavailable']);
    }
}
